pages.title: Sleep, Reworked
pages.text: $(item)Midnight Thoughts$() turns sleep from a simple night-skip into an actual gameplay system: $(thing)dreams and nightmares$() for storytelling, $(thing)buffs and rewards$() for progression, and tracked stats for friendly competition between players.

pages.title: Comfort System
pages.text: How well you sleep depends on the $(thing)comfort$() of your bedroom, scanned in a radius around the bed.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Raises comfort$(): lighting, carpet, furniture, decoration, structure (walls/roof)$(li)$(bold)Lowers comfort$(): macabre blocks, hostile mobs nearby, sleeping in the dark

pages.title: Well Rested
pages.text: Waking up in a comfortable room grants the $(item)Rested$() effect, up to $(bold)5 levels$() depending on comfort.$(br2)$(li)Bonus speed, strength, and mining speed$(li)Extra max HP plus gradual regeneration$(li)Unlike most buffs, the extra HP and regen don't weaken over time - only speed/strength/mining fade through 3 phases

pages.title: Nightmares
pages.text: Let comfort drop too low and the night turns against you.$(br2)$(li)Comfort at or below $(bold)-1$(): you get a $(item)nightmare$() instead of sweet dreams - the calm night sky turns into a slow, pulsing red vignette$(li)Comfort at or below $(bold)-2$(): you can't sleep at all until the room improves

pages.title: Stats & Summary
pages.text: The mod quietly tracks your sleep habits over time and shows them on a $(thing)summary screen$() after waking - turning a good night's rest into something worth comparing and bragging about with friends on the server.
